items.prompt: Why are values and partial declared before the inner jthread scope?

options.text: References then become owning deep copies
Later declaration always prevents every deadlock
options.why: Declaration order cannot prove progress of arbitrary workers.

options.text: The workers are prevented from starting until destruction
options.why: They can start as soon as constructed.

options.text: Worker handles join before their borrowed objects are destroyed
options.why: Inner handle destruction completes while the outer objects still live.

items.explanation: Borrowed inputs/results must remain alive throughout all worker use, including scoped unwind/join.
